slides.label: Verse 1
lines: From deity we hail, with eternal life
The very life and nature of God in us
Your grace is heaped on us abundantly
Of Your fullness we’ve received, unending grace

slides.label: Verse 2
lines: We reign by Your immeasurable grace
Through Your righteousness, oh Lord
In our pathway is life only
And there’s no death of any kind

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: For the law of the Spirit of life in Jesus Christ
Has made us free from the law of sin
And made us death free

slides.label: Verse 4
lines: Lord Jesus, we declare that You are eternal life
Who was with the Father
And made manifest unto us
Imparted to our spirit
That very organic and existential attribute of deity
O o o oh
Life eternal, You are

slides.label: Verse 5
lines: Lord Jesus, You rehearsed divinity to us
That we might follow Your example
You are life itself, revealed to us
You unveiled God to us
And brought us the kingdom

slides.label: Verse 8
lines: We hail from deity
For we were birthed into Your great family
As children of the divine, the most high God
We hail from deity
With unending glory and life eternal
We’re the circumcision that live not after the flesh
But after the Spirit in Christ Jesus
We live by faith and not by sight

slides.label: Verse 9
lines: Our glory life is on
For glorious things are spoken of us
Your love is perfected in us
For we dwell in Your word
We’re the manifestation of eternal life
